description: This file contains benchmark classes for measuring the performance of message dequeuing in an Orleans streaming AdoNet implementation. It defines a benchmark class 'SqlServerMessageDequeuingBenchmark' that inherits from an abstract 'MessageDequeuingBenchmark' class, with setup and execution methods to perform concurrent message retrieval simulations from a SQL Server database, using BenchmarkDotNet attributes.

classes.name: SqlServerMessageDequeuingBenchmark
classes.description: A specific benchmark class for SQL Server, inheriting from 'MessageDequeuingBenchmark', initializing the benchmark with SQL Server invariant and a specific database.

classes.name: MessageDequeuingBenchmark
classes.description: An abstract base class that sets up parameters, storage, and query objects, and defines benchmarked methods for message dequeuing performance testing.

methods.name: GlobalSetup
methods.description: Sets up the database connection and payload before benchmarks run.

methods.name: IterationSetup
methods.description: Prepares test data by truncating the message table and enqueueing messages.

methods.name: GetStreamMessages
methods.description: Performs concurrent retrieval of stream messages, simulating message processing workload.
